notes: LibreChat monorepo. Frontend (Vite dev) on port 3000, API backend on port 3080. API keys (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.) are set to 'user_provided' which lets users enter their own keys in the UI. A placeholder client/dist/index.html is needed because the API tries to read it on startup. The vite.config.ts was patched to support VITE_ALLOWED_HOSTS=true and BACKEND_HOST env var for docker networking.
